about: Findings static_checks.py is told to accept. Each entry: rule (a rule id, or * for any), path (a glob relative to the plugin root, forward slashes, case-sensitive), match (optional regular expression searched in the finding's token -- the offending word, name or text), reason (required: why this one is fine).
Prefer an inline comment on the line itself, '// static-checks: allow(<rule>) <why>', when the file is yours to edit; keep this list for what cannot carry one.
Entries that match nothing are reported at the end of every run: take them out.

allow.reason: F2 is the rename key the comment talks about, not a work item.
Retained rendering redraws on a frame phase; these are its phases, not a plan's.
